note: Parts /Glow recommends. status: tested = the testing checklist for its kind is complete (by /Glow, or by a beta tester who owns it); testing = bought and being checked now. The planner may only recommend items from this list. kind tool and sound items are not controlled by /Glow. Add an ASIN (amazon) or a store link once the affiliate accounts exist; items without one show 'Link coming soon'.

items.name: LightingBugTech Deluxe ambient light kit (Tesla)
items.summary: Fiber ambient kit for Tesla Model 3/Y with a Bluetooth controller /Glow drives directly. The kit /Glow was born on.

items.name: SP630E Bluetooth pixel controller
items.summary: Music-capable controller for addressable (pixel) strips like WS2812B. One per zone.

items.name: SP110E Bluetooth pixel controller
items.summary: Small, low-cost controller for one addressable strip, good behind a TV or desk.

items.name: SP620E USB pixel controller
items.summary: USB-powered controller for short strips: speakers, shelves, monitor backs.

items.name: WS2812B 5V addressable LED strip
items.summary: Individually addressable pixels, so /Glow can run chases and per-pixel looks. Choose the length and density to fit the run.

items.name: 5V 8A power adapter
items.summary: Power for one 5V pixel zone. Check the strip's rated current and leave headroom.

items.name: USB charger, 2A or more
items.summary: Powers USB controllers like the SP620E with short strips.

items.name: Aluminum LED channel with diffuser
items.summary: Hides the dots, spreads the light evenly and helps the strip stay cool.

items.name: 3-pin JST SM pigtails
items.summary: Joins strip sections and extends leads to the controller.

items.name: Trim removal tool kit with fish rod
items.summary: Plastic pry tools for panels and clips, plus a stiff fish rod for pulling wire through door boots.

items.name: Inflatable air wedges
items.summary: Open a gap behind a door card or panel gently, so clips aren't snapped.

items.name: Panel clip pliers
items.summary: Lift door clips and grommets straight out of the metal with little paint contact.

items.name: Model 3/Y door panel clips (spares)
items.summary: Door clips are meant to be replaced when a panel comes off; have spares before you start.

items.name: SMSL PS100 DAC (HDMI ARC)
items.summary: Takes the TV's ARC audio so the TV remote sets the volume; feeds a small amp. Not controlled by /Glow.

items.name: Fosi Audio V3 stereo amplifier
items.summary: Compact amp for passive bookshelf speakers. Not controlled by /Glow.

items.name: Wharfedale passive bookshelf speakers
items.summary: Passive speakers for the DAC and amp chain; leave room off the back wall. Not controlled by /Glow.
